snippet.title: Ragnarock - Viking Music & Summer Skin Packs Trailer
snippet.description:
New Viking Music Pack celebrates Viking Metal Songs with 5 new epic tracks coming to Ragnarock. Get ready for summer with the new Summer Skin Pack. 

Get Ragnarock here:
- Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/3749621795127676/
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1345820/Ragnarock/
- PSVR2: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP7137-PPSA14248_00-0492146559940438
- Viveport: https://www.viveport.com/89026a8b-5b99-46c0-93dd-13a4c4b4ffc3
And on Pico! 

Music Pack includes: 
- Brothers of Metal - Death of a God of Light
- Tyr - Hold The Heathen Hammer High
- Blind Guardian - Twilight of the Gods
- Miracle of Sound - Valhalla Calling (Viking Metal Version)
- Miracle of Sound - Skal (Metal Version)

Summer Skin Pack includes:
- Summer clothes
- Summer beard, hair and facial accessories
- Summer hammer
- Summer boat

Both packs are sold seperately.

Thank you so much for all the support and feedback you give us every day!
WanadevStudio's social accounts are also great spots to share your feelings with us.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ
